OriginalText:
By nature, Digimon are born possessing their own attribute.

Unlike Virus-type Digimon, which reshape their surroundings into environments suited to themselves, or Vaccine-type Digimon, which restore environments ruined by such Virus-types, Data-type Digimon are those that adapt themselves to the environments in which they reside.

Data-type Digimon are an attribute that does not actively alter their environment. However, there also exist Digimon that cannot be classified into any known attribute, or that possess no data at all.

Such Digimon are referred to as “Unknown” Digimon.
